objective: Refine the Tool Discovery observability lower bound into the minimum-reality scheduler cut: consume safe decision-relevant observations before matched comparator evidence, and request comparator evidence only after the cheapest unresolved decision frontier is safe-observation-closed.

three_way_cut.universal_closed_region: No unresolved route is strictly cheaper than the best verified sufficient route; or every route is already disproved. Universal program-side reasoning can finish without comparator evidence.
three_way_cut.safe_progress_region: At the cheapest unresolved decision frontier, at least one unresolved required fact is safely probe-decidable. Take the safe probe first because its result can eliminate a route or establish a least-cost route and thereby avoid comparator spend.
three_way_cut.irreducible_matched_region: At the cheapest unresolved decision frontier, no remaining unknown fact is safely observable. Observationally identical hidden worlds can require incompatible valid/least-cost choices, so matched evidence is irreducible.
